geo_aeo.answer_first_block: A Vector Database is a specialized storage engine designed to index and query high-dimensional embeddings. Utilizing Approximate Nearest Neighbor (ANN) search algorithms like HNSW, it delivers sub-millisecond semantic search capabilities that power modern RAG pipelines and autonomous AI agent workflows.
